review.finding: Flat .trivyignore matches by vulnerability id across all packages/paths, not per package; other minimatch versions (3.1.5 eslint, 10.2.6 typescript-estree) or a future dep could be silenced under the same id without a statement. Dev-only today, low risk.
review.suggestion: Confirm the pre-ignore scan reported each id against exactly one package; state id-wide matching in the header; switch to .trivyignore.yaml with purls + --ignorefile in CI if package scoping is needed.

review.finding: tailwindcss is a devDependency; glob/sucrase appear as production in package-lock.json only via the tailwindcss-animate peer dependency. Conclusion (build-time only) holds but the classification may confuse the 2027-05-01 re-review.
review.suggestion: Add a line explaining the peer-dependency classification; moving tailwindcss-animate to devDependencies is a separate change.

review.finding: Header quotes CI as plain `trivy fs .`; actual command is `trivy fs --format sarif --output sarif/trivy.sarif --scanners vuln,misconfig .`. Conclusion unchanged.
review.suggestion: Reword to 'CI runs trivy fs without --ignorefile, which loads .trivyignore by default'.

review.finding: Fingerprint only applies to history scans; CI runs --no-git and never sees the deleted file.
review.suggestion: Optionally note this in the comment.

review.finding: security.yml is workflow_dispatch-only, so expiry resurfacing is not noticed automatically.
review.suggestion: Record a follow-up for 2027-05-01 or enable the weekly schedule at go-live.

note: Claude-only review; reachability verified in src/ (HashRouter, no useNavigate/navigate/Navigate/redirect, all Link targets literal; glob/minimatch/sucrase not imported from src/scripts/edge/config). Syntax of exp: and gitleaks fingerprint confirmed valid.
